assessment: The source defines the explored interaction ratio V_FB/V_FF over 0 through 1, reports a representative V_FF estimate of 21.2 meV for twisted-bilayer MoTe2 parameters, and treats both interactions as phenomenological parameters. The card’s V_FB=(V_FB/V_FF)V_FF relation, normalization, control, readout, continuous Cartesian interval, applicability, and anchors are source-supported. The 21.2 meV value is explicitly an approximate representative estimate, so deterministic evaluation uses only its printed central value and does not claim measurement precision.

issues.detail: V_FF is reported as an approximate representative scale, not a precision measurement; the card correctly labels this limitation in applicability.

controls.definition: Ratio of the fermion-boson interaction strength V_FB to the fermion-fermion interaction strength V_FF.
controls.name: interaction_ratio

applicability.statement: The interaction scale is an estimate for the representative twisted-bilayer MoTe2 parameters used by the source, so the 21.2 meV normalization is approximate.
The relation covers the weak- through strong-coupling ratio interval explicitly explored in the fermion-boson model.
